selection: After all nine grid attempts: completed natural task episodes only; rank completion first, clipped relative progress/8m second, fewer steps with safety_reasons or paused third, grid index ascending tie-break. Lock top2 codes and all input hashes before new-start verification. Zero code remains eligible. No winner replacement.
headroom_rule: For either locked nonzero candidate on 3 paired new starts: no increase in falls; either at least one paired extra completion with no smaller progress on the other starts, or median relative progress >=1.1*base median. This only supports one separate independent confirmation, not stability or gait qualification.
execution: Two GPUs maximum, one worker per terrain. Nine one-trial frozen child sessions followed by base and two locked candidates with three trials each. Every control step is selection/development cost; child evaluation phase labels do not imply final heldout qualification. No retention phase in this group (positive one-step child retention placeholder unused).
failure_policy: All failures/interrupted attempts and uncertain charges retained. No replacement starts or infrastructure retry of failed stage. Incomplete/collector-cutoff episodes cannot be selected. Fewer than two eligible grid results stops verification. No source changes midgroup.
gait_limits: Fixed joint synergies are not a learned swing-phase policy. Nominal lift only1.74mm; keep existing bounds/gain. No teacher/no extra sensing. No optimizer or actor updates within a rollout.
